## C.1 Frame phrases (PSTE-L5)

A frame announces or closes a response and states no fact. Delete it. These are findings at the start or the end of a text only. The same words inside a text can carry meaning.

| Frame |
|---|
| absolutely |
| anything else |
| as an ai |
| certainly |
| do not hesitate to ask |
| excellent question |
| feel free to ask |
| feel free to reach out |
| good question |
| great question |
| happy to clarify |
| happy to help |
| hope that helps |
| hope this helps |
| i hope this helps |
| i will start by |
| i would be happy to |
| is there anything else |
| let me explain |
| let me help |
| let me know if that helps |
| let me know if you have any questions |
| let me know if you need anything else |
| let me look into that |
| let me start by |
| looking at your |
| of course |
| sure thing |
| that is a great question |
| to answer your question |
